<Heading

  children={"Modify Known Resource Properties"}
>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/resources/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Only allows modification of fields declared as writable by both the resource definition and runtime schema. All field checks must pass before writing; if it fails, a rollback will be attempted. Sensitive fields can be written via dynamic schema, but a successful response will not echo either the request value or the historical value.
